title: Structurable Void
body:
A fork of the «[Structure Voidable](https://modrinth.com/mod/structurevoidable)» mod, this fork updates the mod to 1.21.11 and later versions, also adds a Ukrainian translation (You can also propose your translations on the [GitHub page](https://github.com/StarmanMine142/structure-voidable)!). To learn the main features of the mod, see spoiler Original mod description. The fork will be updated until the [original mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/structurevoidable) is updated.
Original mod description # Minecraft-Structure-Voidable ## Overview The **Structure Voidable** Mod for Minecraft helps the Minecraft content developer by making the **Structure Void** block easier to use. Works in Minecraft 1.21 _Uses ArchitecturyAPI_ Should work as Client-side Only* ---------------------------------------------- ## Features ### Structure Void Behavior - **Barrier Behavior**: Display the Structure Void block as an item in the world similar to the visual style of Barrier and Light blocks. ![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3URi5PhQ/images/f3fbb56a9ea1dbbca64035f21b337162c2b0b6bd.png) - **Voids Everywhere**: A setting to enable the view of the standard Structure Void render regardless of placement within a Structure Block Field
- **Full Block Outline**: The breakable and placeable outline of the Structure Void can be increased to be the size of a full block.
- **Full Block Render**: The standard Structure Void rendered box outline can be enlarged to be a full block.
**Customizable Outline**: Change the color of the Structure Void box outline. ------------------------------------------ ## Installation 1.Download the **Structure Voidable** Mod file.
2.Ensure you have Minecraft Fabric Loader installed.
3.Place the mod file into your Minecraft `mods` folder.
4.Start Minecraft using the Fabric profile.
## Dependencies - Required: ArchitecturyAPI
- Recommended: ModMenu -------------------------------------- ## Configuration ### Mod Configuration File - Located in the config folder, the configuration file allows you to customize various aspects of the mod, such as outline color and outline size.
- ModMenu allows changing of the config while in the game. --------------------------------------- ## Usage ### Structure Void Placement - **On initial install**: All Structure Void blocks rendered in the same method as Barrier blocks.
- **On initial install**: All Structure Void blocks will have the breakable and placeable outline increased to a full block.
- **In the config**: If Voids Everywhere and Full Block Render is turned on, newly placed Structure Void blocks will update with the new style, as well as any Structure Void blocks that get a block update. ------------------------------- ## Contributions Contributions are welcome! If you have ideas for new features, optimizations, or bug fixes, please feel free to open an issue or submit a pull request in the mod's GitHub repository. *I'm not sure if it 100% works client-side only so don't quote me, it still worked when I joined a server that didn't have it. It seems like if the server has it, you have to have it too.
FAQ ### • Will there be any backports? Port to 1.21.6-10 will not. ### • Why does the mod take a long time to update? Updating the mod is possible only when all dependencies are updated, but they take time to update. ### • What versions are supported? The last Game Drop of this year.
